lines.name: Boulevard Line
lines.beyond: south to Southside: through-running; second terminus and depot off-sheet

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north to the Sea Gates via Harbour Road; west to the West End via Crown Road

notes: S2 is withdrawn. Market Street's median breaks for 30.5 m at the Boulevard, over spanStraight 30. So no sky rail can cross the Boulevard except over the circus island. Both west turns would need park ground I cannot prove exists. I did not ask for any rule to be loosened. Tram T2 now serves rocket-west, lantern-west, harbour-east and docks-east.

T2 Harbour Line, from tide's draft but extended: Harbour Road south, Comet Row west, Sunset Way north, Crown Road west. One double running path, r50 = radiusRunning. Both ends leave the sheet, at (310,320) and (-400,289), so it needs no T-L1 loop and has no dead end. Track to plot: harbour-east 48 m, docks-east 48, rocket-west 73, lantern-west 87.

T-C1, checked by hand with rails at ±1.8 m and kept ≥2 m inside the kerbs. Corners cut the inside of each junction, so the track uses outer lanes: Harbour Road x 310, Comet Row z -728, Sunset Way x -347 (south) and -333 (north), Crown Road z 289. Every arc point stays inside one of the two crossing roads' widths.

The Sunset Way corners need opposite lanes, so between z -560 and -500 T2 changes lane, from x -347 to -333 (two 13° r50 fillets). It crosses the 4 m median, which lies inside the 24 m road width. Assumption, unverified: the checker counts the median as street space for T-C1. If not, I will move the lane change to a gap in the median.

N-C1 interchanges: T2 crosses T1 on the flat at (0,-728), with no track link. A T2 stop near (40,-728) is about 55 m from T1 Comet Row (0,-690). A stop near (310,-30) is about 45 m from S1 Harbour (340,0). T1 and S1 still meet at Crown Circus. Every pair of lines now interchanges directly within 150 m.

T1 and S1 are unchanged, listed again only for order. Conflict for Aster: notes.why (e20799…) still describes the old network, and notes.concept says there is one interchange; there are now three. Tide's T2 Harbour Road alignment is kept, but at Harbour Road's south end it turns west along Comet Row. I found no legal terminal loop there.

Evidence gap: I had no shell, so the plan checker was not run. All geometry was checked by hand against the given road widths. The T2 trunk segments are 1048, 657, 168, 62, 789 and 67 m long; the longest fillet tangent (50 m) fits into each of them.

handoffs.ask: Place T2 stops 300–500 m apart, on straight track clear of the r50 corners and the lane change (z -560 to -500). Interchange stops: Comet Row near (40,-728), within 150 m of T1 Comet Row (0,-690); Harbour Road near (310,-30), within 150 m of S1 Harbour (340,0). Re-check reach for rocket-west, lantern-west, harbour-east and docks-east. Drop the S2 stations.

S2 Market Line is withdrawn; drop its timetable. New tram T2 Harbour Line (Harbour Road, Comet Row, Sunset Way, Crown Road) runs off-sheet at both ends. It needs a timetable once Vantage places its stops. T1 and S1 are unchanged.
